title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
prompt: Turn a binary tree into a string, and turn that string back into the identical tree. The trace does both and checks the round trip.

examples.why: The tree survives the round trip. Which encoding was used in between is an implementation detail, and the two approaches here choose differently.
A missing child must be recorded, or this would come back as [1,2] with the child on the wrong side.
